transcript.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 trip when I ended up bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai for a bit.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Shanghai itself was fun though—back then I even kept a little list of attractions in Shanghai so we wouldn’t waste time wandering around.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the train part, my friend had already booked it ages ago: D321 on 2025-03-02, Second Class, and it was under Zhang Wei.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And yeah, the passenger name on that ticket was Zhang Wei—still cracks me up how organized he was about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that month we did Shanghai Disneyland too—Li Na had already handled the tickets for 2025-03-24, morning slot, 5 of us.
